story.sub: Saffron Table opened in 2019 in a former bakery. The kitchen still bakes its own bread each morning, buys from the market down the road, and writes the menu each week around what is fresh. Nothing on the menu stays because it is popular; it stays because it is good that week.
story.title: A former bakery, still baking

tagline: Cooking that respects the season, the market, and the time it takes to do a dish properly.
